gloss: spare time; on the side; sideline; incidentally

definitions.gloss: spare time; on the side; sideline
definitions.explanation: Doing something as a secondary activity while one's main attention is elsewhere; treating something as a side project rather than a primary focus.

examples.japanese: {片手間|かたてま}に{仕事|しごと}をしては{失礼|しつれい}だ。
examples.english: It's rude to do the work half-heartedly.

examples.japanese: {片手間|かたてま}で{絵|え}を{描|か}いている。
{片手間|かたてま}の{仕事|しごと}ではなく、{本腰|ほんごし}を{入|い}れて{取|と}り{組|く}んでほしい。
examples.english: I want you to tackle it seriously, not as a sideline.

notes:
{片手間|かたてま} refers to doing something as a secondary activity.

WORD FORMATION:
- {片|かた} (one of a pair, partial) + {手間|てま} (time/effort)
- Literally: partial effort, using only "one hand"

USAGE PATTERNS:
- {片手間|かたてま}に/で + verb: doing something on the side
- {片手間|かたてま}の + noun: something done as a sideline

NUANCE:
Can be neutral (describing a side activity) or negative (implying lack of dedication):
- Neutral: {片手間|かたてま}で{副業|ふくぎょう}をしている (I have a side job)
- Negative: {片手間|かたてま}でやるな (Don't do it half-heartedly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片手間|かたてま}の{仕事|しごと}: side work
- {片手間|かたてま}に{やる}: to do on the side
- {片手間|かたてま}で{済|す}ませる: to deal with casually

OPPOSITE:
- {本腰|ほんごし}: serious effort, full commitment
